notes: R-M9-45: Tera Shell (Showdown `Pokemon#runEffectiveness`). Turn 1: Close Combat at a full-HP Terapagos-Terastal is resisted, so its Weakness Policy (`getMoveHitData(move).typeMod > 0`) stays. Turn 2: Recover first, then Collision Course gets no super-effective boost (`onBasePower` asks `runEffectiveness`). Turn 3: Recover, then every hit of Bullet Seed is resisted, the later ones below full HP (`abilityState.resisted`).
